action_items: Endpoint naming clarification: review request said GET /api/stats/overview but the implemented route is GET /api/stats. If frontend / clients expect /overview, decide whether to rename the route or update the request docs.
Migrate expo-av plugin in /app/frontend/app.json to expo-audio/expo-video (deprecated).
critical_code_review_comments: stats.py: the .limit(1000) cap is silent — if a tenant has >1000 projects, stats will under-count measurements/avg_steps with no warning. Consider aggregation pipeline ($lookup or $group on measurements.project_id) so the cap is not needed, or at minimum surface a 'truncated: true' flag in the response.

stats.py: the average_steps computation loads up to 1000 measurement docs into Python just to average n_steps. Replace with a MongoDB $group/$avg aggregation for O(1) memory and better latency on large datasets.
stats.py: stats router exposes only /stats (no /overview alias) — review request typo or pending feature, worth confirming with main agent.
